title: 5 Additive Manufacturing Opportunities for Medical Devices
summary: Discover five additive manufacturing opportunities medical device teams often miss, from tooling costs to supply risk. Learn how 3D printing helps you act.
body_markdown:
Complex components may require multiple manufacturing operations, suppliers and assembly steps. Each additional part can add cost, inventory and potential points of failure.


Additive manufacturing can enable difficult geometries and, in suitable applications, consolidate several components into fewer parts—simplifying production and reducing assembly requirements.


***Consider this:*** ** Look at an assembly in your product that relies on several individually manufactured components. Could some of those functions be combined into a single printed part?


**The Upside:**


- Fewer components to source and manage
- Reduced assembly time
- Greater design freedom
- A simpler bill of materials
